title: Smart Classroom Energy Saver
subtitle: Automated energy management system for smart classrooms
desc: Automatically control classroom lights and fans based on occupancy and ambient light levels!
fullDesc: The Smart Classroom Energy Saver automates lighting and ventilation control based on occupancy detection and ambient light levels.
author: Tinkering Lab

hardwareSpecs.occupancyDetection: HC-SR501 Passive Infrared Motion Detector (100° cone, 7m range)
hardwareSpecs.ambientLightSensor: LDR Photoresistor Module with LM393 Comparator
hardwareSpecs.display: 16x2 Character LCD via I2C PCF8574 Backpack
